t: This is 26 South Street, in the W1 part of Westminster. It was designed by John Peter Gandy, an architect who later took the name John Peter Deering. He also had a spell in politics, serving as a member of parliament from 1847 to 1848. There's not a great deal more I can reliably tell you about the house itself, so take a moment to look at the frontage and enjoy it as one more piece of this part of Westminster.
